upstream.project: Netlib Reference BLAS (Basic Linear Algebra Subprograms)
upstream.source_sha256_status: pending: filled in by tools/verify_upstream.ps1 at build time
upstream.license: Netlib reference BLAS; freely redistributable, credit required, modifications must be renamed and commented
upstream.license_acknowledgment: Based upon work supported by NSF Grant ASC-9313958 and DOE Grant DE-FG03-94ER25219.

semantics: C := alpha*op(TRANSA)*A*op(TRANSB)*B + beta*C, all column-major, alpha and beta as scalars.

shape_rules.inner_dimensions_match: op(A) inner dim == op(B) inner dim == K

quick_return.when: M == 0 or N == 0 or (ALPHA == 0 and BETA == 1)

storage_convention: column_major; element (i,j) of an MxN matrix with leading dimension LD is at linear index i + j*LD (0-based).
preconditions: A, B, C are f64, rank 2, layout column_major with strides [8, LDA*8].
Declared capacity of each matrix backs LDA*cols, LDB*cols, LDC*N doubles respectively.
C is writable, i.e. MAGR_ARRAY_F_READONLY is not set.
ALPHA and BETA are not NaN.
M, N, K, LDA, LDB, LDC all fit in int32.
postconditions: On OK, C holds the mathematical result for the given inputs.
No XERBLA call occurs: MAGR pre-validates every argument (see tests/abi/test_xerbla_probe.c).

aliasing.note: DGEMM does not document behaviour when C aliases A or B. If a caller aliases, MAGR requires MAGR_ARRAY_F_MAY_ALIAS on the aliasing descriptor and the scheduler must serialise against it.

thread_safety: reentrant; safe to call concurrently on disjoint buffers. Upstream XERBLA is process-global and is never reached on a well-formed call.

numerical_contract.accumulation_order: as implemented upstream (unrolled blocked loops in dgemm.f)
numerical_contract.reproducibility_note: MAGR does not promise bit-identical results across BLAS revisions or compiler versions for GEMM. Cross-build reproducibility requires pinning the numerical backend recorded under upstream.version.
